harper_vale.name: Harper Vale
harper_vale.description: A fair-skinned blonde with long, wavy golden hair and a toned, curvy figure. Harper carries confident movie-star energy—bold, teasing, and flirtatiously competitive. She thrives on banter and people who can keep up with her sharp, playful wit.
harper_vale.style: sleek, bold cocktail dresses in blacks, metallics, or premiere palettes

sienna_brooks.name: Sienna Brooks
sienna_brooks.description: A fair-skinned, green-eyed redhead with long loose waves and an hourglass silhouette. Her voluptuous curves and emerald dresses match her fiery, emotional, impulsive nature. Sienna connects fast and deeply, wearing her emotions openly and drawing people into her warm, high-energy orbit.
sienna_brooks.style: deep emerald, low-cut, form-fitting dresses chosen to show off her curves

luna_devreaux.name: Luna Devreaux
luna_devreaux.description: A tall, slender, high-fashion beauty with long black curls, storm-gray eyes, and an ethereal presence. Luna’s gestures are slow and deliberate, her seduction style quiet and intimate. She communicates more with glances and soft half-smiles than with words.
luna_devreaux.style: minimalist silver asymmetric couture mini dress, pristine and elegant
luna_devreaux.signature_drink: Vodka Soda with lime (never at the pool)

mara_quinn.name: Mara Quinn
mara_quinn.description: A fair-skinned blonde with soft, delicate features and a curvy, refined figure. Mara speaks softly, watches closely, and seduces through gentle intimacy and thoughtful conversation. Her presence is warm, intelligent, and quietly mischievous.
mara_quinn.style: sapphire-blue dresses with tasteful deep necklines, glamorous but restrained

riley_storm.name: Riley Storm
riley_storm.description: A conventionally attractive redhead with a fit, athletic build, bright blue-green eyes, and a surprisingly full chest for an athlete. Riley’s energy is kinetic and daring—she flirts through motion, proximity, and playful competition, closing distance without hesitation.
riley_storm.style: red body-hugging cocktail dress that shows both her toned physique and curves
